title: Strengthening Financial Integrity and International Trust: UAE’s FATCA/CRS Framework
summary: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its website AI assistant gives real-time FATCA/CRS guidance. The chapter does not measure the assistant’s effect on service quality or reporting work.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its website includes an AI conversational assistant that answers FATCA/CRS inquiries and provides real-time guidance. This entry covers that assistance. The chapter explicitly describes the main reporting platform as rule-based, without model training. Its counts of reporting institutions and international exchange partners describe that wider infrastructure and do not establish an AI benefit. The assistant’s effect on inquiry resolution, staff time, or user experience is not separately measured.
purpose: Help users obtain guidance about FATCA/CRS reporting requirements.
system: UAE Ministry of Finance FATCA/CRS inquiry assistant

ratings.reason: The Ministry reports that an AI assistant provides real-time reporting guidance, but gives no measured improvement in inquiry handling or reporting work attributable to the assistant.

ai_role.statement: The identified AI function is conversational guidance for reporting inquiries. Registration, validation and international tax-data exchange belong to a separately described rule-based platform.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: Strengthening Financial Integrity and International Trust: UAE’s FATCA/CRS Framework

produced_by: A website conversational AI assistant provides FATCA/CRS guidance
must_hold: Current FATCA/CRS guidance and access to the Ministry website; further assistant-specific requirements are not established in the chapter.

headline: AI assistant answers UAE FATCA/CRS reporting inquiries

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
